WorkflowMigrateHint: Analyse the current board in a visual wizard, validate each pipeline and launch a safe, progressive migration.
WorkflowPipelinesHint: A pipeline has a stable identity. Renaming it does not change its links, columns, tickets or routing rules.
WorkflowColumnsHint: Manage the pipeline structure here. To configure a column processor, right-click its header on the board and choose Configure.
WorkflowProjectSkillsHint: Reusable technical and operational procedures shared by the column processors. Their stable key is preserved when renamed.
WorkflowSkillUsage: When should the agent use this skill?
WorkflowPipelineRenamed: Pipeline renamed without changing its stable key.
WorkflowSkillSaved: Skill saved; its stable key was preserved.
MigrationWizardIntro: This board still relies on legacy automations. KittyClaw can analyse it and prepare a visual, reviewable migration to pipelines and column processors.
MigrationBenefitReliableText: Each column owns one processor and KittyClaw controls retries, concurrency and routing.
MigrationBenefitVisibleText: Pipelines, columns, human decisions and terminal outcomes are visible directly on the board.
MigrationBenefitAdaptedText: Development, editorial or operational work can live in separate pipelines with their own rules.
MigrationWizardSafeNote: Nothing is changed during the wizard. Legacy automations are disabled only after their replacement has been configured and verified.
MigrationWizardAnalyzingHint: It is identifying distinct lifecycles from tickets, automations, agents, schedules and routing rules.
MigrationWizardPromptPlaceholder: Describe the change you want, for example: split publishing from editorial production…
MigrationWizardReviewHint: This is the structure KittyClaw will implement. You can still go back to adjust any pipeline or column.
MigrationWizardStartFailed: The analysis could not be started.
MigrationWizardErrorTitle: The proposal could not be prepared
MigrationWizardErrorTooLarge: This board contains too much raw information to analyse at once. KittyClaw will retry from a compact workflow summary.
MigrationWizardErrorInterrupted: The analysis was interrupted, for example by an application restart. You can safely retry it.
MigrationWizardErrorInvalidPlan: The analysis completed but did not return a usable workflow proposal. Retry to generate a new proposal.
MigrationWizardErrorAgentFailed: The planning agent stopped before producing a proposal. Retry the analysis; your board has not been changed.
ProjectOnboardingIntro: KittyClaw will inspect the target folder and propose pipelines adapted to the project it finds there.
ProjectOnboardingQuestionsTitle: Tell us how this project will work
ProjectOnboardingQuestionsIntro: The folder is empty, so a few short answers are needed before KittyClaw can propose a useful workflow.
ProjectOnboardingPurpose: What is this project intended to achieve?
ProjectOnboardingPurposeHint: For example: develop a web application, publish editorial content, produce videos…
ProjectOnboardingDeliverables: What distinct types of work or deliverables will it contain?
ProjectOnboardingDeliverablesHint: Mention work streams that may need different lifecycles.
ProjectOnboardingHumanSteps: Which decisions or validations require a person?
ProjectOnboardingHumanStepsHint: For example: approve a draft, validate a visual, authorize publication…
ProjectOnboardingSchedules: Is any work recurring or scheduled?
ProjectOnboardingSchedulesHint: For example: weekly review, daily publication, monthly report…
MigrationWizardNewPipelineDescription: Describe the purpose and routing of this pipeline.
